evidence.title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness

summary: A new AI system called Prime Agent has been released, featuring a self‑improving reinforcement learning model that can iteratively enhance its own performance. The technology is touted to accelerate autonomous task execution and could set a precedent for future self‑optimizing AI architectures.
title: Prime Agent Introduced as Self-Improving Reinforcement Learning Model Harness
